Jordan (CS): Heads up — customer reporting a regression vs prior model. They say answers that used to reference real product SKU matrix are now inventing a compact “compatibility matrix” with wrong OS versions and ports. Customer excerpt attached.
Maya (ML Eng): Can you paste the exact prompt + response (redact PII)? Also which model/version + routing policy? And a request_id if available.
Jordan (CS): Request id `r-0a3f1b2c`. Prompt snippet: "Generate a compatibility table for WidgetX across supported OS versions and ports". Response (abbreviated):
```
- WidgetX supports Linux 5.1, MacOS 12.8, Windows 98
- Default port: 445
- Certified with ACME Cloud v2.4
```
Customer says these are blatantly wrong (we never supported Windows 98, port 445 is incorrect for this product). This used to be accurate before yesterday's deploy.
Teo (Runtime Eng): Any recent routing or variant swaps? Latency optimizations that could change model variant selection?
deploy-bot: deployment:variant-rollout v3.0 -> 20% (started 2026-03-12T08:15Z)
Jordan (CS): Yes — ops rolled v3.0 variant into canary at ~08:15. Prior stable was `v2.9-curated`. Customers affected show traffic routed to the new variant.
Maya (ML Eng): Did we change any decoding/default sampling params or prompt templates during the deploy? Also want the token counts for the request.
Jordan (CS): token_count: 92. No template change on our end — this is customer prompt directly.
Samir (DevEx): Pasting the full request payload we logged:
```
{
  "model": "widget-compat", 
  "variant": "v3.0",
  "prompt": "Generate a compatibility table for WidgetX across supported OS versions and ports",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```
Maya (ML Eng): Temperature 0.0 but output still hallucinatory. I'll repro locally against v2.9 and v3.0.
Maya (ML Eng): repro notes: v2.9 -> returns a small table citing internal doc IDs and correct ports. v3.0 -> produces enumerated bullet list with invented OS versions and incorrect ports (same as customer). Sample v3.0 output: `WidgetX supports Linux 5.1; Default port 445; Certified by ACME Cloud v2.4`.
Teo (Runtime Eng): Any backend logs showing kernel fallback or micro-batching anomalies? Could KV cache be mismatched causing stale context?
Jordan (CS): I attached the customer-sent example and our request logs to the ticket (internal link). They reported 6 affected requests over ~30 minutes.
Samir (DevEx): Quick ask — can we identify if the model binary differs (quant/ops) between variants? Also was a prompt-shortening optimization toggled for v3.0?
Teo (Runtime Eng): Checking now. Early hypothesis: v3.0 includes newer tokenizer and an aggressive postprocess truncation which may have caused hallucination in short prompts. Also routing changed to prefer low-latency kernels on some GPUs.
Maya (ML Eng): If tokenizer changed, tokenization of product names could get mangled leading the model to 'guess' names/versions. I'll diff tokenization for "WidgetX" between v2.9 and v3.0.
deploy-bot: rollback-suggestion: none (manual)
Jordan (CS): Customer is asking for an ETA / rollback. They consider this a correctness regression impacting docs automation.
Samir (DevEx): Proposed immediate action: 1) Pause v3.0 canary (stop routing new traffic) 2) Roll traffic back to v2.9 for affected orgs 3) Open a P1 investigation if reproducible internally. Anyone object?
Teo (Runtime Eng): Agree. Pausing canary now.
Maya (ML Eng): I'm creating a minimal repro case and will attach model outputs + tokenizer diffs in the ticket. If tokenization is the trigger, we need a mitigation (restore previous tokenizer or add deterministic postprocess).
Jordan (CS): Notified customer we are pausing the variant and routing them back to v2.9; they asked for a rollback log when done.
Samir (DevEx): I'll file an incident and tag eng-runtime + ml + cs. Ticket: INC-2026-1142. Assigning to Teo + Maya.
Maya (ML Eng): Status: repro confirmed locally. Tokenizer mapping for `WidgetX` changed from single token -> split into `Wid` + `get` + `X` under v3.0 which appears to decrease model's ability to recall exact product metadata. Working on patch: either restore tokenization or add a canonicalization pass on product names before send.
Teo (Runtime Eng): Patch plan: hotfix routing + pin affected customers to v2.9 for 24h, then release v3.0 with tokenizer patch behind flag.
Jordan (CS): Customer responded :relieved: appreciates quick action, wants a short postmortem and timeline.
Maya (ML Eng): Will add detailed repro + mitigation notes to the incident. I'll also run a sweep over other product name tokens.
Samir (DevEx): Thanks team. Action items: pause canary (done), pin affected orgs, reproduce & patch tokenizer, postmortem. I'll follow up with communications draft.
Jordan (CS): Closing the loop with customer now. Will post the customer's confirm once they verify outputs.
deploy-bot: variant v3.0 canary paused at 2026-03-12T09:05Z
Jordan (CS): Customer confirms their automated doc generator now returns correct table under v2.9. They will reopen if they see further issues. :thumbsup:
